title: plexWell LP384 Part 2
author: Opentrons
materials: SBP96 Plate, containing samples Slot 3: *Empty* Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather materials and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the PlexWell LP384 Kit (including SBP96 plates with samples from Part 1 and X Solution), an Opentrons P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette, a NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL), and Opentrons 10 µL Filter Tips.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the OT‑2 deck as follows: Slot 1 – 10 µL filter tip rack; Slot 2 – SBP96 plate with samples; Slot 4 – optional 10 µL tip rack (for plate in Slot 5); Slot 5 – optional SBP96 plate; Slot 7 – optional 10 µL tip rack (for plate in Slot 8); Slot 8 – optional SBP96 plate; Slot 9 – NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (X Solution in Column 2); Slot 10 – optional 10 µL tip rack (for plate in Slot 11); Slot 11 – optional SBP96 plate. Slots 3 and 6 remain empty.

substeps.instruction: Load a 10 µL filter tip rack in Slot 1.
Load the first SBP96 plate in Slot 2.
If using additional plates, load a tip rack in Slot 4 and the second SBP96 plate in Slot 5.
If using a third plate, load a tip rack in Slot 7 and the third SBP96 plate in Slot 8.
If using a fourth plate, load a tip rack in Slot 10 and the fourth SBP96 plate in Slot 11.
Place the 12‑well reservoir in Slot 9 and ensure X Solution is in Column 2.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons Protocol Designer, select the PlexWell LP384 Part 2 template, and specify the number of SBP96 plates you will process (1–4). Confirm that the P10 multi‑channel pipette and 10 µL filter tips are selected.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Generate and download the Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file to the connected OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the tip racks, each SBP96 plate, the reservoir, and the P10 multi‑channel pipette using the provided calibration tips.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate the 10 µL filter tip rack(s).
Calibrate each SBP96 plate in its slot.

steps.title: Add X Solution to SBP96
steps.instruction: The robot will use the P10 multi‑channel pipette with 10 µL filter tips to dispense 7.5 µL of X Solution from Column 2 of the reservoir into every well of each loaded SBP96 plate (slots 2, 5, 8, 11).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the protocol and complete the addition of X Solution to all wells.
